remarks: Nestled in one of North Stamford's most coveted cul-de-sac neighborhoods, come fall in love with this stunning, professionally landscaped & meticulously maintained home. Set on a picturesque park-like acre w/ heated in-ground pool, this home is perfect home for both entertaining & a private escape. A sweeping front lawn & stone walkway lead to a gracious full-length porch-the perfect spot for morning coffee or greeting neighbors. Inside, crown molding, wainscoting, & pristine hardwood floors run throughout. The foyer features stunning herringbone floors w/inlay, flanked by a spacious living room & formal dining room. The sun-drenched EIK offers side-by-side Sub-Zeros, double ovens, a large island, & abundant storage. Sliders from the dining area open to a private backyard retreat with a patio, retractable awning, & poolside changing room. A cozy family room w/fireplace & built-ins, a powder room, & a skylit sunroom w/French doors to the backyard complete the main level. Upstairs, the large primary suite includes a renovated bath & generous closets, while 3 large add'l bdrms share a hall bath. The finished LL provides versatile space for a gym, office, or playroom, plus add'l garage access. A spotless oversized garage, whole-house generator, stone walls, mature landscape, hardie board siding & fully fenced yard complete this exceptional home-minutes to downtown New Canaan, Scotts Corner, the Merritt Parkway & all Stamford has to offer. See feature sheet for add'l info.
